project_context.user: Cédrick (Founder), highly mobile, construction sites, workshop
project_context.goal: Miraculous mobile-first redesign of a 9-panel ERP dashboard without breaking desktop

theme_and_archetype.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Industrial Utility
theme_and_archetype.theme: Light mode prioritized (for high-glare environments like construction sites) with heavy Navy structural elements
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Needs absolute clarity under sunlight. High contrast ensures readability. Navy base grounds the brand.

headings.usage: Page titles, KPI numbers, Status badges

body.usage: Client names, descriptions, standard form labels

breakpoints_strategy.mobile: Default (no prefix). All classes should target mobile first (e.g., flex-col, p-4, text-base).
breakpoints_strategy.desktop: md: (min-width: 768px) and lg: (min-width: 1024px). Use these to revert to the existing desktop table/tab layouts (e.g., md:flex-row, md:table, md:p-8).

navigation.mobile: Bottom Tab Bar for Top 4 routes (Dashboard, Invoices, Calendar, Clients). A 'More' tab opens a Bottom Sheet for the remaining 5 routes (Suppliers, Products, POs, BOL, Prospecting). Removes the overflowing horizontal tabs.
navigation.desktop: Keep existing sidebar or top tabs using md: block / hidden classes.

data_display_tables.mobile: Convert all tables to Stacked Data Cards (Bento style). No horizontal scrolling.
data_display_tables.card_layout: Header: Tech-stamp ID (left) + Status Badge (right). Body: Main identifier (Client Name/Product) in large Plex Sans. Footer: Key metric (Amount/Date) + Quick action button (icon only).

modals_and_forms.mobile: Replace centered modals with full-screen views or Bottom Sheets (<Sheet side='bottom'>).
modals_and_forms.long_forms: Break into vertical sections with sticky bottom action bars. The 'Save/Confirm' button MUST always be fixed to the bottom of the viewport (pb-safe-area).
modals_and_forms.inputs: Height min 44px (touch target). Use native numeric keyboards for amounts.

kpi_tiles.mobile: 2-column grid (grid-cols-2 gap-4). The main KPI (e.g., Month Revenue) spans full width (col-span-2). Use Barlow Condensed for massive numbers.

calendar.mobile: Do not use a 6x7 grid on mobile. Use a collapsible weekly strip (1 row of 7 days) at the top, and a vertical 'Agenda List' of the selected day's events below it. Add a FAB to quickly create an event.

touch_gestures_and_interactions.swipe: Implement Swipe-to-Action on List items (Invoices/BOL). Swipe Right -> 'Mark Paid' (Green). Swipe Left -> 'Delete/Cancel' (Red).
touch_gestures_and_interactions.long_press: Long-press on a list item activates 'Multi-Select Mode' (shows checkboxes).
touch_gestures_and_interactions.fab: Floating Action Button in the bottom right for primary context actions (New Invoice on Invoice page, New Prospect on Prospect page).

atomic_components_to_create.name: MobileTabBar
atomic_components_to_create.description: Fixed bottom navigation bar visible only on mobile (hidden on md:).

atomic_components_to_create.name: DataCard
atomic_components_to_create.props: title, subtitle, badge, amount, onSwipeRight, onSwipeLeft
atomic_components_to_create.description: The universal replacement for table rows on mobile.

atomic_components_to_create.name: MobileSheet
atomic_components_to_create.description: Shadcn <Sheet side='bottom'> customized with 90vh max-height and a sticky bottom action area.

atomic_components_to_create.name: StickyActionBar
atomic_components_to_create.description: Fixed bottom bar for forms and multi-select modes, ensuring actions are always reachable by thumb.

mark_invoice_paid.steps: User opens Invoices -> Swipes right on an unpaid invoice -> Tap 'Mark Paid' confirmation -> Badge turns green. (2 actions, 0 modals).
mark_invoice_paid.alternative: Tap invoice -> Opens Bottom Sheet -> Massive 'Mark Paid' button sticky at the bottom.

create_appointment.steps: Tap FAB (+) on Calendar view -> Bottom Sheet opens -> Title input -> Native Date/Time picker -> Tap 'Save' sticky button.

prospecting_campaign.steps: Header has a 'Selection' icon. Tap it -> Checkboxes appear next to all prospects. Tap multiple -> A sticky bottom bar appears showing 'N Selected' and a giant Red 'Confirm/Send' button.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='mobile-tab-dashboard', data-testid='invoice-swipe-paid'.
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons and icon links.
testing_and_accessibility.safe_areas: Use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for bottom bars to prevent collision with iOS home indicator.
